plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into dexterity-backed poison scaling
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade efficient damage and Footwork; secure reliable block, discard Beckons, preserve a useful potion, and enter healthy enough for vulnerable attack turns.
plan.summary: Improve damage before adding speculative combos. Add dexterity, efficient block and poison scaling; remove Strikes after securing attacks. Fight elites with health and potions, balancing essential upgrades against healing.
